title: Ember Drift
description: Pilot a saffron spark through a collapsing star field. Collect embers, dodge drifting debris, chase your best run. Original MPC demo title — 6 KB, zero imports.

title: Saffron Run
description: A neon three-lane sprint toward a burning horizon. Switch lanes, grab gold, never stop. Original HTML5 demo title.

title: Mishrin D3D11 Test
description: Windows 64-bit Direct3D 11 compatibility title. Runs on a cloud worker under Wine with DXVK → Vulkan and streams to any device. Arrows move, A scores; progress is saved in the cloud.

title: Mishrin D3D9 Test
description: Windows 32-bit Direct3D 9 compatibility title (WoW64) on a cloud worker with DXVK. Arrows move, A scores.

title: Throne of Embers
description: Slot for your Windows fantasy title. Attach your legally owned game file and MPC streams it from a cloud compatibility node.

title: Apex Monsoon
description: Slot for your Windows action title. Attach the game file to play locally or through the cloud.

title: Void Sentinel
description: Slot for your Linux sci-fi title. Runs on an isolated cloud Linux node.

title: Valley of Dawn
description: Slot for your HTML5 or WebAssembly exploration title. Attach a .html or MPC .wasm package to play instantly on this device.
